map.单位边际贡献 = 单价 − 单位变动成本: Unit Contribution Margin = Price − Unit Variable Cost
map.边际贡献先覆盖固定成本。: Contribution margin first covers fixed costs.
map.单品盈利性分析，判断某产品是否值得继续生产或保留。: Single-product profitability analysis to judge whether a product is worth continuing to produce or keep.
map.多产品组合优化时，优先排产高单位边际贡献的产品。: When optimising a multi-product mix, schedule products with a high unit contribution margin first.
map.测算降价空间：在仍为正边际贡献范围内可短期促销清库存。: Estimate the room for price cuts: within the range where contribution margin stays positive, short-term promotions can clear inventory.
map.某产品售价 80 元、单位变动成本 50 元，单位边际贡献=80−50=30 元: A product sells for 80 CNY with a unit variable cost of 50 CNY, so the unit contribution margin = 80−50 = 30 CNY; with monthly fixed costs of 30,000 CNY, 1000 units must sell before fixed costs are covered and profit begins.
map.单位边际贡献和毛利有什么区别？: What is the difference between unit contribution margin and gross profit?
map.单位边际贡献=单价−单位变动成本，用于本量利与短期决策；毛利=收入−营业成本，含: Unit contribution margin = price − unit variable cost, used for cost-volume-profit and short-term decisions; gross profit = revenue − cost of sales and includes allocated fixed manufacturing overhead, so it is a broader measure.
map.边际贡献为负为什么要停产？: Why stop production when the contribution margin is negative?
map.边际贡献为负意味着每卖一件多亏一件的变动成本，停产可止损；但若能覆盖部分固定成本: A negative contribution margin means each unit sold adds a loss equal to its variable cost, so stopping limits the damage; but if it still covers part of the fixed costs, continuing to produce in the short term loses less than stopping.
